name: Hernandez Lawncare And More, LLC
source: Google Maps (listing has no website button, only a Facebook link)
address_note: No public address on the Google Business listing; this is normal for a mobile residential lawn care operation. Adapted variant used per PIPELINE.md Fase 3.5: map section replaced with a real completed-job photo and a service-area description instead of an address/map embed.
own_site_check: Tested domain variants (hernandezlawncare.com - SSL/DNS error, no site; hernandezlawncareandmore.com - resolves but is a DIFFERENT company, 'Hernandez Lawn Care and More' serving Jacksonville, North Carolina, phone 910-333-5337, unrelated to this Cape Coral FL business verified by phone area code and service area; hernandezlawncarefl.com - no DNS). WebSearch for the business name plus city found no owned domain. Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100072032842064) is the only public link on the Google listing; Facebook does not count as an own website per PIPELINE.md.
email_search: Checked Facebook profile page (blocked public scraping, no About text retrievable), WebSearch for business name + city (no public email found). No email published anywhere found.
hours: Monday to Sunday, 7 AM to 6 PM (per Google Business hours)
language_note: All Google reviews found are in English; business operates in an English-speaking South Florida market.
brand_vibe: Light, natural daylight palette: deep forest green + warm cream, reflecting real lawn/landscaping photography (manicured lawns, palm trimming, topiary).
services_found: Lawn mowing and maintenance (confirmed via photos of manicured lawns)
Landscaping / garden design and planting (confirmed via garden bed photo and review from Paul Dworianyn mentioning a landscaping project with Julio)
Palm and tree trimming (confirmed via photo of active palm trimming job)
Hedge / topiary shaping (confirmed via photo of shaped topiary bushes)
pricing: Not published anywhere (no booking platform, no price list). Adapted variant: site shows "Pricing by quote" instead of fabricated prices, per PIPELINE.md Fase 3.5.

reviews_used.author: Johnny Natal
reviews_used.text: This company gets the job done! After my old lawn guy sold his business to another owner who would find ways to add hidden additional charges each month I was in need of finding someone to maintain my property. My property has man bushes …

reviews_used.author: Donald Bischoff
reviews_used.text: Hernandez Lawncare is the best. They are on time, very neat, and overall a quality lawn service. I would recommend to anyone.

reviews_used.author: Paul Dworianyn
reviews_used.text: I recently hired Julio for a landscaping project, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! From the very beginning, Julio took the time to listen to what I envisioned for my yard. Not only did he incorporate some of the plants I already …

reviews_used.author: Jeff Gratz
reviews_used.text: Working with company two years and happy. They are solid.We receive a quality job, timely with hard working caring staff! No problem discussing any issues or things we need done

reviews_note: One 1-star review (Rick Cline, missed appointment) exists on the listing and is reflected honestly in the aggregate rating/review_count shown on the site (4.8 of 76), but was not selected as a testimonial quote, consistent with standard practice of curating representative positive quotes while keeping the real aggregate rating visible.
photos_source: 7 Google Maps listing photos downloaded via scripts/_gmaps_photos.py, all verified real and relevant after visual contact-sheet review (manicured lawns, garden bed, palm trimming in progress, tropical landscaping, backyard lawn, topiary). No selfies or portraits found or used.

build.base_template: templates/light/index.html (copied and edited, not written from scratch)
build.palette: custom (forest green / cream), tokens follow DESIGN.md structure
adapted_sections: Ritual 4 pasos -> 'How We Work' (generic, realistic lawn-care service process, no specific fabricated claims about this business)
Servicios -> 4 real service categories with 'Pricing by quote' CTA instead of fixed prices
Ubicacion/mapa -> omitted map (no public address); replaced with real completed-job photo + service area description
build.bilingual: data-es/data-en on all translatable nodes except the hero H1 (split-word animation owns its DOM, consistent with the ejemplar's own pattern). Default language en with toggle to es.
build.gate_checks: em-dash count 0, no <details>, DOCTYPE/html closed, JSON-LD valid, all image paths exist, design-system markers present (text-shine/orb/glass/btn-3d/reveal/Playfair/merktop-badge/data-es/split-word/sec-num/tile-cap/cursor-ring/foot-mark/heroInner), assets/tailwind.js copied locally.
